research.title: Negation Sensitivity in Sentence Similarity Models
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare sentence similarity models on meaning changes introduced by negation and lexical substitution.
Constructed controlled sentence pairs, evaluated similarity score shifts, and inspected errors to distinguish lexical overlap effects from sensitivity to negation.

research.title: Cross-Domain Robustness of Intent Classification
bullets: Planned experiments with supervisor guidance to examine intent classification under domain shifts, using matched label sets and source-only training baselines.
Implemented evaluation splits and compared lexical and contextual representations, analyzing confusion patterns across domains and checking sensitivity to training sample selection.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Sequence Taggers for Entity Recognition
bullets: Implemented a conditional random field baseline and a bidirectional recurrent sequence tagger for entity recognition using consistent preprocessing and label conventions.
Compared entity-level precision and recall, inspected boundary errors, and evaluated how capitalization features affected predictions on unfamiliar entity mentions.

projects.title: Lexical and Dense Retrieval for Question Matching
bullets: Implemented term-weighted retrieval and pretrained sentence embedding baselines to rank candidate questions for semantically related user queries.
Compared ranking metrics under shared candidate pools, examined paraphrase failures, and tested the effect of query normalization on retrieval behavior.
